description: Standalone Morphe patches for Gboard Rambler: Hex by Anomaly Listening & Processing waveforms (Dot Scope, Android Wave, Flow/Pulse/Sweep, colors, Strip/iOS halo tuning), Custom Instructions, Personal Dictionary (MUSE_STATS), Contact Names, Cursor-Aware & Append-Only Editing, and App Context.
